# `BattHiTempShutdown`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Envelope-only warning sent just before the device shuts down for battery over-temperature.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | event (device sends) |
| Grade | PURE GETTER |
| Side-effect tier | B |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, CPiStatusChecker::BatteryChange @0x12b3e0 (64-bit build) |

Broadcast on TCP 4700 (channel I) from the high-temperature branch of the battery-change handler, before the event server is stopped and the shutdown action is selected; expect the connection to end shortly after. No timer on the emitter. Family N (Event and Timestamp only). The PiStatus battery members describe the associated condition. APK consumers: DeviceEventPart; ConnectService.

Side effects: Observation only for the receiver. On the device the same branch stops the event server and starts a shutdown.

## Request params

None. Events are sent by the device without a request; the payload is below.

## Payload

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Event` | string | yes | - | Discriminator. Fixed value `"BattHiTempShutdown"`. [READ] |
| `Timestamp` | string | yes | - | Decimal string with nine fractional digits from a monotonic clock; not a calendar time. [READ] |

## Errors

None. Failures appear in the payload (`code`, `error`) when `state` is `fail`.

## Example

Event, shutdown - READ shape, not captured:

```json
{"Event":"BattHiTempShutdown","Timestamp":"1234.123456789"}
```
